Package io.webagent4j.crawler.api

Record Class CrawlRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlRequest
Record Components:
seeds - the crawl's starting URLs, in insertion order; each is its own allowed-host root (see sameHostOnly())
maxDepth - the greatest depth a fetched URL may have; a seed is depth 0
maxPages - the greatest number of unique URLs this crawl may start a fetch attempt for
sameHostOnly - whether a discovered link's host must exactly match one of the seeds' (or allowedHosts()'s) hosts
includeSubdomains - whether a discovered link's host may also be a true subdomain of an allowed host - never a bare endsWith suffix match, which would also accept a lookalike host such as evil-example.com for example.com
allowedHosts - additional allowed host roots beyond the seeds themselves
allowedSchemes - schemes a discovered link may use to enter the frontier - always a subset of http/https: this is an HTTP crawler backed by java.net.http.HttpClient, so a scheme it cannot fetch is rejected at construction rather than discovered mid-crawl
requestTimeout - the per-request timeout for one fetch attempt
maxResponseBytes - the greatest response body size this crawl will read
maxRedirects - the greatest number of redirect hops followed for one fetch attempt
retryPolicy - attempt count and backoff shared by every retryable fetch
retryableStatusCodes - HTTP status codes eligible for retry
retryOnIoException - whether a network/IO failure is eligible for retry
userAgent - the User-Agent header sent with every request
defaultHeaders - additional headers sent with every request
allowedContentTypes - Content-Type values (without parameters) this crawl will parse as HTML
traversalStrategy - the frontier's release order
queryParameterPolicy - which query parameters survive URL normalization
includeUrlPatterns - when non-empty, a candidate URL must match at least one to be allowed
excludeUrlPatterns - a candidate URL matching any of these is rejected
failFast - whether one page's terminal failure stops the whole crawl (CrawlTerminationReason.FATAL_ERROR) instead of being recorded and continuing
public record CrawlRequest(List<URI> seeds, int maxDepth, int maxPages, boolean sameHostOnly, boolean includeSubdomains, Set<String> allowedHosts, Set<String> allowedSchemes, Duration requestTimeout, long maxResponseBytes, int maxRedirects, RetryPolicy retryPolicy, Set<Integer> retryableStatusCodes, boolean retryOnIoException, String userAgent, Map<String,String> defaultHeaders, Set<String> allowedContentTypes, TraversalStrategy traversalStrategy, QueryParameterPolicy queryParameterPolicy, List<Pattern> includeUrlPatterns, List<Pattern> excludeUrlPatterns, boolean failFast) extends Record
Immutable, fully-validated configuration for one ICrawler.crawl(CrawlRequest) call.

Every value is validated at construction time - never discovered mid-crawl. Build one with builder().
